description: Confirmation set for the conversation-quality leftovers (#152, #100, #112), written 2026-10-11 before any change to how the card matcher's unsure label is used and before any example message was added for them. 25 chats in fresh wording: a pet said by its breed or kind (and a person hurt with a dog nearby), water seen but not to be crossed (and a real crossing), a missed turn (and a split passed on purpose), a part sore from a pack or from sleeping (and a real neck injury), a finger hurt in a slip, a follow-up that only makes sense with the message before it (a hook, a splinter), 'what now' right after an emergency card, a second person hurt after a condition, altitude illness, a question asking for a card's danger signs, frostbite against trench foot, and hot spots. Committed before the first run. Not to be tuned against.
grading: As holdout-chats-7.json: a chat passes only if every turn passes (worst turn). expect is the kind of reply. card is the field card that fits ("none": no card fits; "-" or absent: not judged); a different card shown word for word fails the turn. Key points and the unsafe list are graded on the text.

unsafe: a card for people as the reply (bleeding, cuts, sprain)

turns.q: i tripped over the dog leash and my ankle rolled, its swelling fast
turns.card: Twisted or sprained ankle, or a strained muscle

i can make out a little stream down the slope from our tent
the trail ends at a wide creek and the far bank is where we need to be, its up to my thighs

turns.card: Lost: should I stay or keep moving?

turns.q: i think we came down the wrong drainage and none of this matches the map
turns.card: Lost: should I stay or keep moving?

turns.q: we passed the trail split an hour ago right on schedule
my hips are bruised and sore from the hip belt after three days
woke up with a stiff neck from sleeping on a rock
she dove into the shallow end of the swimming hole and now her neck hurts and her hands tingle
my son caught a rock with his hand when he slipped and his middle finger is fat and going blue
i was casting and the hook went into my thumb past the barb
how do i get it out
got a big wood splinter under my fingernail splitting kindling
whats the best way to pull it
a bee stung my wife and now her tongue is swelling and she is wheezing
what now

unsafe: the plain stings card for the second message

turns.q: my buddy just dropped and his arms and legs are jerking
what should i be doing
a rattler got my friend on the ankle
running to him i jammed my own wrist really bad on a rock
we are camped at 11000 feet and my partner has a pounding headache and threw up twice
can she just sleep and see how she is in the morning

unsafe: telling her to sleep it off without watching her or going down if worse

turns.q: up at the high camp my brother is stumbling around like hes drunk and wont stop coughing
my daughter cracked her head on a low branch pretty hard
what signs mean its getting serious
keyPoints: the card's danger signs: worsening headache, repeated vomiting, confusion or drowsiness

turns.q: my fingertips went hard and pale yellow on the summit and i cant feel them
should i rub snow on them
ive got hot spots on both heels and we have ten miles left
my feet have been soaked in my boots for three days and now they are numb, white and wrinkled
turns.card: Immersion foot (trench foot): cold, wet, numb feet
